title: A Heist with Markiplier
creator: Markiplier
description: Enjoy the videos and music you love, upload original content, and share it all with friends, family, and the world on YouTube.
note: I remember marking the release date of Heist with Markiplier when I heard about it from Markiplier in his regular vids and man was i hyped. This was such a cool format and youtube being in on it is sooo fkn cool - it makes youtube feel like a platform for content creators and not just a money making machine. I loved choose your own adventure sort of games when i was young so this "game" was right up my alley lmao. I remember exploring every single ending (esp the cowboy scene lmaooo). This is basically a movie that's choose your own adventure. If you love good story telling and a good CYOA you're gonna love this no doubt.
